text:
Rina (PM): ok team, last call to finalize GA scope for the Console Observability workstream. we have limited cycles so we need razor focus. my suggestion: GA must include dashboard templates (quick-apply), hot-path tracing hooks with basic span sampling controls, per-route estimated cost, and an error-drilldown that links to traces. everything else goes to v1.x. thoughts?
Omar (Eng): sounds good. engineering constraints: hooking spans into hot-paths + providing per-route cost estimates requires a small index and nightly rollups. estimate: 2 sprints for core, dashboards gallery 1 sprint, error-drilldown 1 sprint.
Hannah (SRE): operational constraints: we need clear quota & throttling behavior. recommend hosted default retention 7d, dedicated 30d. also require auto-fallback to summary traces when ingestion crosses threshold. define SLOs before canary.
Luis (Design): for GA I'll deliver 3 gallery templates (api performance, frontend latency, cost spotlight). will include sample-size and sampling-rate indicators on every panel. deliverable in 4 working days if prioritized.
Tasha (CS): customers consistently ask for CSV export of cost tables and a simple "top-10 routes by spend" widget. include that in scope? it's high impact for early adopters.
Rina (PM): include CSV export (lightweight) but ship full billing export later. top-10 routes widget as part of dashboards gallery is ok.
Nadia (Security): residency note: we must document storage locations and key management for Hosted vs Dedicated. also require audit log for export config.
Omar (Eng): default sampling config I propose:
```
tracing:
  default_sample_rate: 0.05
  hot_path_override: 0.9
  retention_days_hosted: 7
  retention_days_dedicated: 30
  throttle_policy:
    enabled: true
    burst_limit: 5000
    fallback: summary_traces
```
Omar (Eng): question for product: default_sample_rate 5% or 1%? 5% gives better signal but higher cost.
Tasha (CS): customers want to see the math. include an "estimated $/route" badge (toggle) so they're not surprised. marketing likes the visibility.
Hannah (SRE): SLOs suggestion for canary/beta: dashboard p50 <200ms, p95 <600ms; trace join success >97% for mirrored traffic; fallback mode must trigger within 2min of sustained quota breach. add rollback criteria: any sustained >3% error increase in customer-facing endpoints during canary.
Rina (PM): acceptance checklist for GA (musts):
- 3 beta customers (enterprise, midmarket, startup) signoff on UX & perf
- Dashboard gallery + top-10 routes widget + CSV export
- Tracing hooks deployed to mirror traffic with sampling visibility
- Cost estimates within 7% median error for top routes
- Error drilldown with trace link working end-to-end
- Security/residency doc, export audit logs
- SLOs documented and rollback tested

Omar (Eng): engineering notes: pre-aggregation plan: keep 24h real-time index, nightly rollups for older ranges. queries beyond 24h hit rollups (less granularity). this reduces QPS on query service.
Luis (Design): small UX detail: show a badge when data is sampled or throttled, with hovertext that explains effect on visibility.
Nadia (Security): export sink config changes must write to audit log and require admin role. I'll add a short checklist for the docs.
infra-bot: deploy-queue: current length 5, avg_wait 1.5m. recommend extending canary window by 24h this week.
Tasha (CS): I'll reach out to the candidate beta customers today. want to include a short feedback checklist: dashboard usefulness, cost accuracy, sampling transparency, and error root-cause confidence.
Rina (PM): action items: Omar -> sampling + throttle doc + POC for cost calc by Fri. Luis -> gallery mocks + sampled-state badge by Thu. Hannah -> SLO doc + rollback criteria automation by Mon. Nadia -> residency & audit checklist by Wed. Tasha -> beta invites + feedback checklist by Thu. I'll own GA checklist and release notes.
Omar (Eng): one more ask: make sure pricing team sees the infra cost estimate before GA. nightly rollups/storage cost affects margins.
Rina (PM): noted, will loop in finance. last call: anything to move to MUST that we haven't listed?
Hannah (SRE): add alerts for sampling-rate drops below expected thresholds; must be in beta.
Luis (Design): small ask: include a tiny "Why this matters" help tooltip on the cost widget so customers understand estimate vs invoice differences.
Rina (PM): great. closing thread 1 — will publish consolidated plan and create JIRA tickets. thanks everyone! :rocket:
